product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Back-to-Back Portrait and Landscape Displays Fits 43 to 65 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Back-to-Back Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 43" to 65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Back-to-Back Landscape and Portrait Displays is engineered for two-sided digital signage in open commercial environments. Using a tensioned wire design, this system securely mounts two landscape or portrait-oriented displays back to back between the floor and ceiling—creating a clean, modern presentation visible from both sides. This mount is ideal for retail signage, menus, wayfinding, and informational displays in high-traffic indoor spaces where wall mounting is not an option.Supports two landscape or portrait-oriented displays back to back on a single tensioned wire systemSupports 43" to 65" portrait displays and 50" to 65" landscape displays with a maximum load capacity of 55 lbs (25 kgs) per screenCompatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mmMaximum floor-to-ceiling height of approximately 3300 mm (129.9 in)Ideal for retail aisles, open floor plans, and glass-fronted commercial spacesTensioned wire architecture delivers a modern floating appearance without wall attachmentOptimized for landscape or portrait widescreen content including menus, dashboards, and promotionsDesigned for indoor commercial use; professional installation recommended BACK-TO-BACK LANDSCAPE DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONSupports two flat-panel displays mounted back to back, allowing content to be viewed from opposite directions—perfect for open floor plans, aisles, and glass-fronted spaces. FLOOR-TO-CEILING WIRE MOUNT ARCHITECTUREA tensioned steel wire system anchors securely between the floor and ceiling, delivering a floating look without walls while maintaining commercial-grade stability. DESIGNED FOR LANDSCAPE OR PORTRAIT DISPLAYSOptimized for landscape or portrait orientation, making it ideal for widescreen content such as menus, dashboards, promotions, schedules, and digital signage. ADJUSTABLE MOUNTING HEIGHTThe wire-based system allows installers to set display height within the available floor-to-ceiling span, adapting easily to different room layouts and viewing distances. BROAD VESA COMPATIBILITYSupports VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mm, covering a wide range of commercial flat-panel displays in landscape or portrait orientation. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with tensioned wire components provides rigidity and stability for high-traffic indoor commercial installations.
